Headline findings by country

North Macedonia Validated

48 reform issues: 19 High, 24 Medium and 5 Low priority; 33 persistent, 5 improving and 2 worsening; 20 gaps open and 27 partly addressed.

  • This overview lists the 48 reform issues identified for North Macedonia in RUN-2026-01: 14 under Chapter 2 (Freedom of movement for workers) and 34 under the cross-cutting technology and AI theme.
  • All values shown are judgements validated by the analyst at G6.
  • Nineteen issues are rated High priority (4 in Chapter 2 and 15 in the technology theme, one of them set to High by the analyst at G6), 24 Medium and 5 Low.
  • The dominant pattern is persistence: 33 of 48 issues have a persistent direction of travel, and no Chapter 2 issue is judged to be improving.

From the scope overview signed off at G7.

How to read this page

  • All countries are analysed with the same method and one shared list of reform issues, so the same issue can be compared across countries. A new country can add issues to the shared list only through a gate.
  • Only judgements validated at a country's G6 are shown, with the latest validated value where a judgement was re-run. Nothing proposed or in progress is compared.
  • Priority, direction of travel and gap are judgements about each country on its own evidence. A difference between countries is a prompt to read both country pages, not a ranking.
  • The country pages hold the evidence, quotes, comparator cases and draft policy options (internal drafts).
